periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique; the primary axes of the eye patches are angled downward and outward at approximately 45 to 60 degrees from the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval; the vertical dimension of the patches is significantly greater than the horizontal width, approximately a 1.7:1 ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Teardrop morphology with a pronounced downward tapering where the lowest point of the patch is distal to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band at the lateral shoulders occupies approximately 30% of the visible vertical height of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation; the gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex semicircular arcs with no visible flattening at the tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-tone discoloration/soil staining across the ventral abdominal fur and a single bamboo stalk held in the right forepaw.
